name: quality-playbook-harness
description: Orchestrate Quality Playbook runs across multiple repos from one Claude Code session. The harness skill drives a disk-backed state machine via in-session ScheduleWakeup polling: each tick dispatches QPB worker subagents (Task tool), tails their heartbeats, advances the state machine, prints a status table, and reschedules — until every run reaches a terminal state or you write a STOP file. No external scheduler, no long-running daemon; the same ScheduleWakeup primitive the v1.5.7 watcher has run reliably for weeks.
